assumptions.text: Go forbids import cycles, so 2.2.2 and 2.2.4 always score 10; read hierarchy problems from subsystem cycles and 2.1.x instead.
A Go package-level named type stands in for the dissertation's class; the MMI's class thresholds were calibrated on Java, C# and PHP.
A line of code is a line on which a token other than a comment starts; test files and generated files are left out of every measure.
Number of Statements counts every statement except blocks, labels, empty statements and case clauses, including a for loop's init and post.
Cognitive complexity is github.com/uudashr/gocognit's SonarSource count; a function above 15 is a cognitive-complexity warning.
Criterion 1.3.4 uses the modified cyclomatic complexity, above 15.
large type > 400 lines, large function > 60 lines, large package > 40 types, largest tolerable type cycle group 5, large file > 800 lines, deepest nesting 4: borrowed guidance, not the chapter's.
1.2.1, 2.1.1, 2.1.2 and 3.2 divide violating imports or references by all candidates between different groups; the chapter gives no denominators.

Communities are gonum's Louvain communities (resolution 1, a fixed seed) of the package graph taken as undirected, an edge weighing the imports either way, each split into its connected parts. A package of a subsystem with other packages is misplaced when another subsystem holds more of its community than its own. They are advice and never gate.

Dependencies are the imports and references go/types resolves in the build the report reads, for its platform and tags; reflection, dispatch by string and struct tags are not followed. The imports of files the build constraints exclude are read from their source and checked by the import rules alone: forbidden imports, isolations, and fitness's layer access, strict layers, onion, dependents and libraries; graphs, cycles, fan-out and metrics measure the build.
Criteria 2.2.3 and 2.2.4 use the largest cycle group.
MMI = Σ weight(group) × mean(scores); unscored criteria count 0 toward the low bound and 10 toward the high bound.
LCOM4 links methods to the fields and methods they select through the receiver; a field no method uses is left out.
Decoupling Level (Mo et al., ICSE 2016) is not computed: US patent 11,422,800 covers its algorithm.
Martin's metrics count in-scope imports only; abstractness is the share of named types that are interfaces, and instability is 0 for an isolated package.
Component Rank is PageRank over type dependencies with damping 0.8, run for a fixed 50 iterations; types that depend on nothing spread their rank evenly.
SDI cuts are exact for cycle groups of up to 12 elements and use the Eades–Lin–Smyth ordering above that; Coupling.CutMethod says which.
